segments.sn55.2:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
segments.sn55.2:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.2:2.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.sn55.2:2.4: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.2:2.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
segments.sn55.2:3.2: Idaṃ vatvāna [vatvā (sī. pī.) evamīdisesu ṭhānesu] sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.sn55.2:4.3: Te ve kālena paccenti, brahmacariyogadhaṃ sukhan”ti.

lines: Dutiye yesaṃ saddhāti padena buddhe pasādo gahito.
Dhammadassananti padena dhamme pasādo gahitoti evaṃ cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni vuttāni.
Brahmacariyogadhaṃ sukhanti brahmacariyaṃ ogāhitvā ṭhitaṃ uparimaggattayasampayuttaṃ sukhaṃ.
Yo panesa gāthāya āgato pasādo, so katarapasādo hotīti.
Ubhopi therā paṇḍitā bahussutā, ubhinnaṃ subhāsitaṃ.
Sotaṃ ariyamaggaṃ ādito patti sotāpatti, tassā aṅgāni sotāpattiyaṅgāni.
Missakappasādo esoti tasmā ubhopi therā paṇḍitā bahussutā.
